description: Find the tempo of any song — tap along to the beat and get a live BPM readout with beat-interval stats.

faqs.a: Tap at least twice; more taps give a steadier average. The last 16 taps are used.
faqs.q: How many taps do I need?

faqs.a: Yes — the readout shows the average BPM plus the fastest/slowest recent taps.
If you stop for more than 3 seconds, the tap history resets automatically.
Yes — big tap area, fully mobile friendly.

howto: Tap the big button (or press Space) on every beat.
Watch the live BPM update with each tap.
Check min/max to see how steady the tempo is.
title: BPM Tap Tempo
